question: 能否在完整长基因上下文中联合标注启动子、UTR、CDS、内含子、剪接边界和TES
candidate_sources: 现有258个NCBI GenBank/RefSeq assembly的FASTA+GFF3；只纳入高质量可调用区域
release_status: current source available; task release not built
split_rule: 最高层genus/assembly隔离；蛋白家族和15-mer近重复去泄漏；长基因长度分层
native_capability_contrast: AgroNT/NT-v2短上下文不能一次看到完整64K/128K；必须另报chunked track；PlantCAD2/PlantCaduceus/HyenaDNA/Caduceus为真正长上下文对手
success_rule: 相对最强native plant baseline macro-F1下界>0且绝对提升>=0.02；相对最佳chunked短模型>=0.03；Holm校正
claim_boundary: GFF注释预测，不等于新基因功能或湿实验验证

question: 局部2K序列近似相同时，远端顺式调控背景能否决定启动子/TES活性
label_type: paired binary/ranking with local-context matched pairs
candidate_sources: 现有GFF/FASTA用于结构候选；Plant Genomic Benchmark cassava PRO-seq及后续冻结的作物PRO-seq/CAGE/PAS-seq作为功能标签
release_status: candidate sources partly available; exact functional accessions must be frozen
split_rule: 按物种/实验study隔离；中心2K GC、motif、同源度匹配；远端序列置换作为反事实控制
primary_metrics: paired AUPRC; pair accuracy; context gain; calibration
native_capability_contrast: 短模型在native track看不到被设计为决定标签的远端区域；PlantCAD2/PlantCaduceus等长模型仍可公平竞争
success_rule: 64K相对2K paired AUPRC提升CI下界>0；相对最强native baseline>=0.02；远端置换必须显著消除增益
claim_boundary: 只有功能测序标签可支持调控活性；纯GFF版本只能称结构上下文任务

question: 能否利用完整基因上下文预测组织/胁迫条件下的可变剪接和可变poly(A)使用
label_type: multi-label junction/polyA usage; delta-PSI or usage regression
candidate_sources: 公开作物Iso-Seq/long-read RNA-seq与配套短读长RNA-seq；NCBI SRA/ENA；exact accessions TBD
release_status: not frozen; no current formal result
split_rule: study×species隔离；gene-family cluster disjoint；表达可检测性callable universe
native_capability_contrast: 长内含子和多个候选位点超出AgroNT/NT-v2单窗口；chunking作为弱等价对照
success_rule: 相对最强native baseline AUPRC>=+0.02或Pearson>=+0.03且CI下界>0
claim_boundary: 预测转录本使用，不直接证明表型因果

question: 能否识别小麦/棉花/油菜同源亚基因组基因的表达优势、抑制或平衡状态
candidate_sources: NCBI/Ensembl Plants参考与亚基因组注释；公开多组织RNA-seq/Expression Atlas；exact releases/accessions TBD
release_status: not frozen; no current formal result
split_rule: 整套homoeolog group不可跨split；按gene family、品种和study隔离；表达批次train-only归一化
primary_metrics: macro-F1; macro Pearson; within-triad ranking accuracy
native_capability_contrast: 作物多倍体特有；通用非植物NT-v2无植物预训练，AgroNT虽植物专用但native上下文较短；PlantCAD2/PlantCaduceus为关键强基线
success_rule: 超过max(AgroNT,PlantCAD2,PlantCaduceus,NT-v2-500M,Evo2)的同口径最强值，MMED=0.02 F1或0.03 Pearson，CI下界>0
claim_boundary: 表达优势不是亚基因组进化机制或育种价值的直接证明

question: 能否从含/不含TE插入的等位/单倍型序列对预测表达方向和幅度变化
label_type: paired ref/alt delta regression + direction classification + TE boundary
candidate_sources: 作物pan-genome/SV release + EDTA高置信TE + matched RNA-seq/eQTL；exact source releases TBD
release_status: blocked until EDTA QC and paired functional labels are frozen
split_rule: 同一variant pair同split；按locus/gene family/品种隔离；仅callable matched negatives
primary_metrics: delta-expression Pearson; sign AUROC/AUPRC; boundary F1; calibration
native_capability_contrast: 256K超出当前AgroNT/NT-v2和本地Evo2-8K；PlantCAD2/PlantCaduceus/HyenaDNA/Caduceus按真实native能力进入
success_rule: 相对最强native长模型Pearson>=+0.03且CI下界>0；相对序列组成/SV长度基线显著
claim_boundary: 不得把缺失TE或无表达测量样本当负例；关联不等于因果

question: 能否在重复富集的抗病NLR基因簇中识别完整基因、伪基因和簇边界
label_type: token segmentation + intact-copy count + cluster classification
candidate_sources: 高质量作物组装；经NLR-Annotator/人工注释交叉确认的NLR registry；exact release TBD
release_status: not frozen; computational labels require manual QC tier
split_rule: 按NLR family cluster和作物genus隔离；重复相似度分层；近重复去泄漏
primary_metrics: boundary F1; copy-count MAE; macro-F1; low-homology sensitivity
native_capability_contrast: 长重复簇是作物育种专属难点；短Transformer只能chunk；长植物模型是主要对手
success_rule: boundary-F1>=+0.03或copy-count MAE相对降低>=10%，bootstrap CI支持且低同源子集保持
claim_boundary: 计算预测NLR结构，不代表抗病表型或功能验证

question: 能否跨作物预测组织/胁迫特异开放染色质与远端调控元件
candidate_sources: 公开作物ATAC-seq/DNase-seq/PRO-seq；木薯PRO-seq现有；其余exact accessions TBD
release_status: one cassava task available; cross-crop panel not frozen
primary_metrics: macro-AUPRC; per-tissue AUPRC; calibration; cross-species transfer
native_capability_contrast: 检验作物特异调控语法；NT-v2不含植物，AgroNT是强植物短上下文基线，PlantCAD2/PlantCaduceus是强植物长上下文基线
success_rule: 通用任务对最强植物基线非劣（AUPRC差CI下界>-0.02）；作物长程子集优效>=+0.02
claim_boundary: 开放染色质不等于增强子，也不等于目标基因因果调控

question: 能否从成对单倍型长序列预测基因PAV/SV类别及其转录影响
label_type: paired structural variant classification + expression delta
candidate_sources: 水稻/玉米/大豆/小麦公开pan-genome和配套表达；exact release/crosswalk TBD
release_status: not frozen; no current formal result
split_rule: locus和haplotype group隔离；群体/品种最高层bootstrap；reference bias audit
primary_metrics: macro-F1; delta-expression Pearson; top-k locus ranking
native_capability_contrast: 复杂SV无法由单个512-bp窗口完整描述；长植物模型仍作为公平强基线
success_rule: 对最强native长模型达到预注册MMED并在非参考单倍型子集保持
claim_boundary: PAV/SV预测不等于农艺性状因果

question: 能否在QTL/GWAS区间内排序有实验或精细定位支持的候选基因/变异
candidate_sources: 公开作物GWAS/QTL/fine-mapping与功能验证registry；exact version and gene-ID crosswalk TBD
split_rule: 整个位点和study同split；按染色体/群体隔离；禁止nearest-gene伪标签
primary_metrics: MRR; hit@1/5/10; locus-level AUCPR; bootstrap by locus
native_capability_contrast: 这是育种决策任务，不仅是通用序列分类；所有基础模型还必须与距离、功能注释和传统精细定位强基线比较
success_rule: 对最佳序列基础模型和最佳非深度强基线均达到预注册MMED；否则只报告诊断价值
claim_boundary: 候选排序不能宣称发现因果基因；必须保留实验验证需求
